text:
emma (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need to lock SI handoff rules for the new cloud marketplace listings. TL;DR: who claims leads, how to split ARR, and announcement cadence. I put a draft below. Thoughts?

roberto (Sales): +1 we need clear guardrails. Are we splitting by ARR size or territory? Also need to ensure AE gets notification within 15m.

megan (Solutions): Recommend: SI claims technical leads < $50k, Sales owns > $50k, co-sell for prospect > $200k. Also require joint intro call within 48h.

ajit (SE): For technical fit checks, SE should be tagged automatically. Can we add `si_tag=true` to intake payload?

emma (Partnerships): Proposal: ruleset v0.1:
```
- claim_rules:
  - if annual_value < 50000: assign -> SI_primary
  - if annual_value >= 50000 and annual_value < 200000: assign -> Redwood_sales
  - if annual_value >= 200000: assign -> Co-sell_evaluation
- notification_window: 15m
- intro_call_window: 48h
- overlap_resolution: 24h exclusive claim then Partnerships arbitration
- intake_fields_required: [company_name, estimated_arr, territory, si_partner_id, capability_match_score]
```

ci-bot: New playbook draft uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-playbooks/handshake-v0.1

lisa (RevOps): I can add routing in the intake flow — need exact field names. Also we'll require `si_conflict` checkbox for overlap cases.

roberto (Sales): For overlap resolution, propose: 24h exclusive claim window then arbitration by Partnerships. Keep it lightweight.

megan (Solutions): Add `capability_match` score in intake so we can auto-route to SI or Redwood-managed. Prefer a 0-100 score.

ajit (SE): Also note training: SI partner onboarding call for integration checklist — we should schedule weekly office hours next month.

emma (Partnerships): Can we spin up a pilot with 2 SIs for Q2? Volunteers: @roberto to pick candidate deals, @megan to run tech quals.

roberto (Sales): I'll nominate two: ACME and BlueRidge, both in NA. I'll ping privately.

lisa (RevOps): I'll track KPIs: lead-to-launch time, conversion, and overlap incidents. Create a tiny dashboard.

megan (Solutions): minor ask — add support SLA expectations in the playbook: 3 business days triage for SI-introduced bugs.

emma (Partnerships): Awesome. I'll update the draft and drop in confluence. Ping here when changes made. :thumbsup:
